title: Most frequent character (with a tie-break)
prompt:
Return the **most frequent character** in the string; on a tie, return the alphabetically **smallest** of the tied characters. The string is non-empty and lowercase.

Examples: `"aabbbc"` → `'b'`; `"abab"` → `'a'` (a and b tie, a wins).

tests.name: frequent char
tests.hint: Count each char's occurrences; replace only on strictly-greater count, or equal count with a smaller char.
